name: PM-KISAN (Farmer Income Support)
description: Provides direct income support of Rs. 6000/year to landholding farmer families.
steps: Apply online at pmkisan.gov.in with land records and Aadhaar card.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin
description: Financial assistance for building a house for rural families without a pucca house.
steps: Apply through your local Gram Panchayat office with income and residence proof.

name: National Old Age Pension Scheme
description: Monthly pension support for elderly citizens below the poverty line.
steps: Apply at the local Social Welfare Department with age and income proof.

name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (Crop Insurance)
description: Insurance cover for crop loss due to natural calamities, pests, or disease.
steps: Apply through your bank or Common Service Centre before the crop season deadline.

name: MGNREGA (Rural Employment Guarantee)
description: Guarantees 100 days of paid unskilled manual work per year to rural households.
steps: Register for a Job Card at your Gram Panchayat office.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
description: Savings scheme for the welfare of the girl child, offering high interest returns.
steps: Open an account at a post office or authorised bank with the girl child's birth certificate.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC Students
description: Scholarship covering tuition and maintenance for OBC students in post-matric education.
steps: Apply through the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) with caste certificate.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST Students
description: Scholarship covering tuition and maintenance for SC/ST students in post-matric education.
steps: Apply through the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) with caste certificate.

name: EWS Reservation Certificate Benefits
description: 10% reservation in government jobs and education for Economically Weaker Sections not covered by other reservations.
steps: Apply for an EWS certificate at your local Tehsildar/Revenue office with income and asset proof.

name: Stand-Up India Scheme (SC/ST/Women Entrepreneurs)
description: Bank loans between Rs. 10 lakh and Rs. 1 crore for setting up a new enterprise.
steps: Apply through any scheduled commercial bank branch or standupmitra.in.
